title: agentToolAdmission
responsibility: Validates model proposals, resolves tool scope through the trusted adapter and applies specialty content checks.

inputs.name: allowsAgentTool.policy
inputs.description: The current host policy for the agent.

inputs.name: allowsAgentTool.admission
inputs.description: Validated adapter arguments, resource, action and policy snapshot.

inputs.name: admitAgentTool.options
inputs.description: Trusted tool definitions, current agent policy, durable journal, clock and optional independent classifier.

inputs.name: admitAgentTool.agentId
inputs.description: Host-assigned identity for the agent whose grants apply.

inputs.name: admitAgentTool.proposal
inputs.description: Bounded, untrusted JSON with a tool name and exact tool arguments.

inputs.name: agentToolContentDenial.options
inputs.description: Trusted tool definitions, current agent policy, durable journal, clock and optional independent classifier.

inputs.name: agentToolContentDenial.admission
inputs.description: Validated adapter arguments, resource, action and policy snapshot.

outputs.name: allowsAgentTool
outputs.description: Whether the current declaration, grant, revision and specialty authorize the resource.

outputs.name: admitAgentTool
outputs.description: The canonical admitted action or a fixed denial code.

outputs.name: agentToolContentDenial
outputs.description: A content denial reason when screening is required and fails or rejects the content.
